scenarios.name: Open the Tools Options additional command area

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Options additional command area is closed
the user opens the Options additional command area
it appears beneath the Options panel over the viewport
the active part and model browser remain visible
the user clicks empty viewport space
the Options additional command area closes
the Tools ribbon and part remain visible
